_comment: One entry per contract area. A test belongs to the area named by its folder under tests/contract. 'required' lists the backends that must pass the area: add "dotnet" when the area's port issue is done, and CI then fails the .NET run on that area instead of only reporting it.

areas.name: auth
areas.description: Sign-in, sessions, CSRF, bootstrap, cookies, CORS and HTTP hardening.

areas.name: system
areas.description: Suite settings, logs, configuration bundle and backups, pause, health and readiness, metrics, notifications, directory browsing.

areas.name: activity
areas.description: Activity feed, stream, export and file history.

areas.name: media_managers
areas.description: Media manager connections and capabilities, the intake webhook, and hand-off status.

areas.name: jobs
areas.description: Job inspection, manual enqueue, reconciliation and worker behaviour visible over HTTP.

areas.name: refiner
areas.description: Refiner libraries, rule sets, files, operator and runtime settings, overview stats, direct play, hardware and maintenance APIs.

areas.name: processing
areas.description: Black-box processing scenarios with fake media managers and fake ffmpeg: hand-off, retry, pass-through, reject, crash recovery, pause and schedule.
